meta.selection_rule: of the 1000 evaluation episodes (gymnasium seeds 100000-100999), the successful one with the most swings (direction reversals of the car), ties broken by the longer one, then by seed order: episode 230 (gymnasium seed 100230), 2 swings, 114 steps
meta.agreement_definition: held-out expert demonstrations: the expert driving from 500 new default starts (states never used in training), as in the paper
meta.swings_definition: direction reversals of the car (sign changes of its velocity) in each successful evaluation episode; keys: number of swings, values: number of episodes
meta.det_by_wl_definition: per frame, 8 lists of K values: detected power of each output at each wavelength, input power 1 at every wavelength; their mean over the wavelengths is det
meta.contrib_definition: per frame, 3 lists of 8 values: contrib[a][w] = sum over the wavelengths k of W[a, 8k + w] det_by_wl[w][k]; contrib[a] summed over w plus readout_bias[a] is scores[a]. The share per detector is defined up to one number per wavelength (the 8 readings at a wavelength add up to the input power, so adding one number to an action's 8 weights at that wavelength, the bias compensating, changes no score); the exported W is the minimum-norm readout (its sum over the 8 detectors is 0 at every wavelength), and the animation's readout lines use it

sweep.definition: per frame, sweep_col_power[j] and sweep_arm_power[j] are col_power and arm_power at the single wavelength wavelengths_nm[j] (index wavelength_index[j] into meta.wavelengths_nm), input power 1 at every wavelength, 3 significant digits, in every frame but the last (the state at the flag, never swept); the last column of sweep_col_power[j] is det_by_wl at that wavelength. The animation sweeps the wavelength across meta.wavelengths_nm at every step, shows the light in the network at the current wavelength (interpolated between these wavelengths) and draws each detector's reading (det_by_wl, all K wavelengths) as the wavelength advances

mesh.arm_profile: each arm: width 500 nm, then piecewise-linear through the 5 listed widths, back to 500 nm; 7 points equally spaced over the 10 um taper
mesh.upper_is: the first (lower-index) waveguide of each pair; waveguide 0 is drawn at the top

encoding.description: phase on port p = a_p x + b_p v (x, v scaled to [-1, 1]); a_p, b_p fixed random, normal with scale 1.5 pi; equal amplitude on the driven ports (driven_ports), no light on the others; phases given modulo 2 pi
encoding.name: random_1p5pi
